summary: @servicetitan/react-ioc preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundle
details: The package declares preinstall: 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is an obfuscator.io-style script (hex-mangled identifiers, per-scope string-map indirection) that, on npm install, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temporary directory, extracts and chmods the binary (unzip / PowerShell Expand-Archive / manual inflate paths), and then execFileSyncs that binary against math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line bundle prefixed '// @bun @bun-cjs' containing a rotated string-array decoder and mangled identifiers; it is not referenced by dist/index.js (the package's declared main) and is only reachable via the preinstall Bun handoff. A React IoC/dependency-injection library has no functional need for the Bun runtime or for a Bun-only opaque bundle executed at install time. Because the payload is executed by a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime rather than Node, its actual behavior is shielded from Node-based static analysis. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape, obfuscated loader, hidden Bun-only payload, and mismatch with the advertised package purpose together constitute install-time arbitrary code execution on the installer's host.
